title: Cancelled Shonen Jump Creator Returns With a New Series Ahead of Anime’s Debut
content: It’s no secret among manga fans that Shonen Jump often cancels series for varying reasons. It doesn’t have much to do with the story; rather, sales or viewership matter most to publishers. In February 2024, Shun Numa returned to Weekly Shonen Jump with a new gag humor series, Super Psychic Policeman Chojo .
author: ComicBook

title: Futurama Reveals Season 14 Preview of New Character, Coco Charm (Exclusive)
content: Earlier this month, Hulu welcomed back the world that introduced us to the likes of Fry, Bender, Leela, and the other employees of the Planet Express for its fourteenth season. Rather than releasing all the episodes of this latest season at once, Futurama has instead decided to go with a weekly schedule.
author: ComicBook

title: Boruto Next Generations Streaming on BBC iPlayer
content: The website AnimeBluRayUK reports that BBC iPlayer is now streaming the 66 TV episodes of the series Boruto: Naruto Next Generations in their English-dubbed version. The series premiered on TV Tokyo in 2017, featuring an original story.
author: ANN

title: Upcoming Anime Screenings at London's Prince Charles Cinema
content: The Prince Charles cinema in Leicester Square, London, will screen several anime films into November. Tickets for the films are available here and all the screenings are subtitled. Makoto Shinkai 's your name.
author: ANN

title: Ani-One Asia Licenses Chitose Is in the Ramune Bottle Anime's 2nd Part
content: Ani-One Asia announced on Wednesday it has licensed the second cours (quarter of a year) of the television anime of Hiromu and raemz 's Chitose Is in the Ramune Bottle ( Chitose-kun wa Ramune Bin no Naka ) light novel series. Ani-One Asia is streaming an English-subtitled trailer for the series.
author: ANN

title: Odex to Screen Detective Conan: Fallen Angel of the Highway Film in Singapore
content: Odex announced on Wednesday it will screen Detective Conan: Highway no Datenshi ( Detective Conan : Fallen Angel of the Highway ), the franchise 's 29th film , in Singapore. Odex did not announce an opening date for the film, but revealed the movie will screen exclusively in Golden Village cinemas.
author: ANN

title: A New Surprising Amazon Live-Action Anime Adaptation Has Been Announced
content: Streaming services seem to always be looking for new content, with many platforms such as Netflix, Hulu, Tubi, and more always searching for the next big thing. With the popularity of cinematic universes like the MCU, it makes sense that streaming outlets would be looking to established stories to hit the screen.
author: ComicBook
